content.body:
Once disregarded as an effective fighter, the Bf 110C was fitted with a bomb rack and became the first true fighter/bomber in history. While faring slightly better at this task than other aircraft the 110's true time in the sun would not come until it was gunned up as a heavy bomber destroyer and pitted against the huge formations of USAAF B-17's and B-24's in the Luftwaffe's final gasp, and to an even greater extent as a dedicated nightfighter, where it run amok through British RAF night bomber formations.
The F/B fighter bomber is the same as the earlier Bf 110 but you have a couple of very potent bombs on board, an extra 250 hp (for each engine) to lug them around with, an improved MG151/20, and a 20 mm cannon in place of the older MGFF/M 20 mm versions. Use the F-B as a support fighter against mechanized infantry and light tanks. The 250 kg bomb can peel open just about any Allied tank, and you get 2 of them. Take a friend along as your tail gunner when you are in a support role to help keep your tail clear and add some insult to injury as you pull off a bomb or strafing run.
Bf 110's were often referred to as "Zerstörers" (Destroyers), while the term "Jabo" ... short for "Jaeger Bomber" (Fighter Bomber), can mean any fighter that performed in that bombing or CAS role.
The following crew positions are controllable: 1 Pilot 2 Tail Gunner
content.brief: TYPE: Ground Attack MAX. SPEED: 560 km/h WEIGHT: 7,145 kg CREW: 2 ARMAMENT: 20 mm MG151/20 Cannons (2) 7.92 mm MG17 LMGs (4) 7.92 mm MG15 LMGs (1) SC250 250 kg Bombs (2)
